statements.status_notes: Verified: the CVE describes insecure deserialization in spring-web's HttpInvokerServiceExporter (and related HessianServiceExporter / BurlapServiceExporter / RemoteInvocationSerializingExporter). The vulnerable exporter classes ship inside spring-web-5.3.39.jar at org/springframework/remoting/httpinvoker/ and org/springframework/remoting/caucho/, but nothing in /usr/share/data-prepper/lib/ references them at link time: grepping every bundled jar for the strings 'HttpInvokerServiceExporter', 'HessianServiceExporter', 'BurlapServiceExporter' produces zero matches outside spring-web-5.3.39.jar itself, and the same grep across data-prepper-*.jar (the data-prepper-authored classes) returns nothing. DataPrepperServer is constructed against com.sun.net.httpserver.HttpServer (verified by string-scanning the compiled DataPrepperServer.class), so no HTTP exporter endpoint accepts the serialized payload the CVE requires. The vulnerable code path is not reachable.
